datapack.comptes_resultat_bilans_valides: Approved income statements and balance sheets, calculated EBITDA and working capital
datapack.pont_ebe_comptable_ebe: Bridge from reported to normalized EBITDA
datapack.parametres_sources_dates_modifiables: Sourced, dated, editable parameters (copper cells on cream background)
datapack.dette_nette_bfr_normatif: Net debt, normalized working capital, non-operating assets
datapack.methode_2_flux_tresorerie: Method 2: discounted cash flows over 5 years
datapack.saisie_ou_hypothese_modifiable: Input or editable assumption (copper on cream): flows through all tabs.
datapack.formule_se_recalcule_seule: Formula: recalculates on its own, do not overwrite.
datapack.total_ou_resultat_methode: Total or result of a method.
datapack.montants_euros_valides_par: Amounts in euros approved by the owner; negatives in parentheses, zero shown as “–”.
datapack.estimation_indicative_non_contractuelle: Indicative, non-binding estimate. It does not replace the opinion of an accountant, a lawyer or an M&A advisor. Passation assumptions are sourced and dated in the tab “
datapack.bfr_exploitation_stocks_clients: Operating working capital (inventories + receivables − payables − tax and social liabilities)
datapack.bfr_jours_chiffre_affaires: Working capital in days of revenue
datapack.cellules_cuivre_sur_fond: Copper cells on cream background are editable. Passation sources are dated; “To be completed” = no verified public source.
datapack.completer_aucune_source_publique: To be completed: no verified free public source
datapack.reponse_dirigeant_capital_detenu: Owner’s answer (at least 75% of capital held by individuals)
datapack.bfr_jours_ca: Working capital in days of revenue
datapack.poids_multiples_dans_synthese: Weight of multiples in the summary (the DCF gets the remainder)
datapack.facteur_applique_aux_valeurs: Factor applied to enterprise values (1 + sum)
datapack.remuneration_normative_directeur_salarie: Market-rate pay of a salaried manager
datapack.loyer_paye_locaux_dirigeant: Rent paid (premises owned by the owner or a property company)
datapack.remuneration_dirigeant_ramenee_normale: Owner’s pay brought back to a normal level
datapack.loyer_ramene_prix_marche: Rent brought back to market price
datapack.dette_nette_bfr_actifs: Net debt, working capital and non-operating assets
datapack.bfr_reel_dernier_exercice: Actual working capital, latest fiscal year
datapack.bfr_normatif_jours_moyenne: Normalized working capital in days (average of fiscal years)
datapack.passage_ve_titres_ve: EV → equity bridge = EV × discount factor − net debt + working capital gap + non-operating assets
datapack.beta_endette_beta_desendette: Levered beta = unlevered beta × (1 + (1 − tax rate) × D/E)
datapack.cout_fonds_propres_taux: Cost of equity = risk-free rate + beta × premium + size premium
datapack.valeur_terminale_gordon_shapiro: Terminal value (Gordon growth) = year-5 cash flow × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)
datapack.presente_part_comme_plancher: Shown separately, as a negotiation floor.
datapack.controle_poids_multiples_poids: Check: weight of multiples + weight of DCF = 100%
datapack.pied_synthese: Indicative, non-binding estimate. Calculations are reproduced with formulas: edit the copper cells in the “{onglet}” tab.

hypotheses._lisez_moi: Labels from src/data/hypotheses.json (values, sources and dates stay in that file); « facteurs »: discounts and premiums, by key.

taux_sans_risque.libelle: Euro risk-free rate: 10-year spot rate of the AAA-rated euro area government bond curve
taux_sans_risque.note: Damodaran method: euro risk-free rate (AAA government); France’s country risk is counted in the risk premium below, not in the rate.

prime_risque_marche.libelle: Equity risk premium for France (mature market 4.23% + country premium 0.78%)

prime_taille.libelle: Size and specific risk premium of an unlisted SME
prime_taille.note: To be completed. No verified free public source (the usual references, such as Kroll Cost of Capital Navigator, are paid). Until it is filled in, the DCF is not calculated and the summary relies on multiples alone.

cout_dette_avant_impot.libelle: Pre-tax cost of debt: average rate on new loans to SMEs in France

impot_societes.conditions_taux_reduit: Revenue for the fiscal year ≤ €10,000,000; capital fully paid up and at least 75% held by individuals (or by a company itself at least 75% held by individuals).

croissance_terminale.libelle: Perpetual growth (terminal value): ECB medium-term inflation target, i.e. zero growth in volume

betas.libelle: Cash-corrected unlevered beta and industry debt-to-equity ratio (Western Europe)

decotes_primes.note: To be completed: no default percentage is sourced. Each factor starts at 0%; the owner (or their advisor) sets the slider and writes the justification.

facteurs.taille: Size and liquidity of the shares

ponderation.note: Owner’s decision of 11/18/2026 (replaces the one of 11/10): multiples only by default; the DCF is calculated and shown as an option (cross-check), enabled through the weighting; adjusted net assets are shown separately as a floor.
